Between-subject REPAIR structural regression on MEDuSA mixed models

Source: R/diagnose_crossrun_recovery.R
medusa_between_subject_repair.Rd

Connects fitted lme4::lmer() (or mixed_by model objects) from MEDuSA Stage 4 directly to repair::repair() (Vig & Hallquist, 2026) to estimate measurement-error-corrected between-subject regressions relating subject-specific neural random intercepts/slopes across brain regions or to external behavioral/clinical variables.

Usage

medusa_between_subject_repair(
  formula,
  models = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  id = "id",
  regularization = c("step_up", "minimum", "none", "custom"),
  cross_model_error = NULL,
  medusa_mlm = NULL,
  subject_data = NULL,
  id_col = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

Structural regression formula using repair::re() markers (e.g., re("x_whitened", model = "target") ~ re("x_whitened", model = "seed") + age).

models

Named list of fitted lme4::lmer or nlme::lme models (or a single fitted model).

data

Subject-level data.frame with one row per subject ID.

id

Character scalar naming the subject ID column in data (default "id").

regularization

Regularization policy passed to repair::repair(): "step_up" (default; adaptive M-MOMS), "minimum", "none", or "custom".

cross_model_error

Cross-model prediction-error covariance policy when models has multiple entries (defaults to "independent" when length(models) > 1L).

medusa_mlm

Optional alias for models (e.g., a single fitted lme4::lmer model).

subject_data

Optional alias for data.

id_col

Optional alias for id.

...

Additional arguments passed to repair::repair().

Value

A list with coefficients (tidy data.frame from repair::repair_coefficients()), reliability (from repair::repair_reliability()), predictions (likelihood-only random-effect predictions and error variances), and fit (the S7 class_repair_mod object).
